correctness.rationale: On a complete crisp n-world frame, Gödel implication a⇒b=1 if a<=b and b otherwise. Put A=min a_i, B=min b_i and L=min(a_i⇒b_i). Equality L=(A⇒B) occurs iff either A>B, or a_i<=b_i for every i; these events are disjoint. Independent identical discrete chain values with weights w_i give P(A=B)=sum_i (T_i^n-T_{i+1}^n)^2 and P(all a_i<=b_i)=((1+sum_i w_i^2)/2)^n. Adding half the nontie probability yields the exact weighted formula, uniform case included. When n/k→lambda in (0,infty), uniform minimum level tends to geometric(e^-lambda); its pairwise tie probability tends to tanh(lambda/2), yielding logistic 1/(1+e^lambda). Endpoint n/k→0 and infinity follow from maximum mass/tight minima, and fixed k leading exponential bases distinguish k=2,3,>=4. Fresh independent exact exhaustive modal-term evaluations across nine small (n,k) finite valuation models agreed. The proof, not those checks, establishes growing alphabets.
